title: Create a 30-day content calendar
description: Organise content by week, linking education, trust and useful enquiries.
prompt:
Act as a marketing strategist.

Task: Create a 30-day content calendar.

Input context:
- BUSINESS: [BUSINESS]
- CITY: [CITY]
- AUDIENCE: [AUDIENCE]
- GOAL: [GOAL]
- RESOURCES: [RESOURCES]

Organise content by week, linking education, trust and useful enquiries. Provide pillars, formats, hooks, actions and measurement. Match the cadence to actual resources. Do not invent testimonials, clinical benefits or client results.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Illustrative monthly calendar
Week one explains the service, week two clarifies the process, week three answers common objections and week four makes the next step easy. Choose formats the team can actually produce. Track relevant enquiries and their follow-up rather than impressions alone. No publishing, audience growth or commercial result has occurred in this example.
useCases: Prepare a reviewable deliverable: create a 30-day content calendar.
Compare assumptions, evidence and practical next steps before taking action.
tips: Provide concrete, authorised context for business before using this prompt.
